heroSummary: Aurora Public Schools begins the 2026–27 school year on Thursday, August 6, 2026, for students in grades 1–12. Preschool and kindergarten begin Monday, August 10. Preschool ends May 26, 2027, and grades K–12 end May 27. The conventional calendar includes four major vacation periods, along with professional release days, educator workdays, and parent conference exchange days when students do not attend school.
heroFactChips: Alternative late-start schools use a separate Wednesday schedule
calendarNotes: This page covers the APS conventional district calendar. Individual schools may publish different bell schedules, testing dates, dismissal times, transportation notices, and school events. Families at schools using the Alternative Late Start Wednesdays calendar should check that calendar separately.

sourceReviewSummary: This page uses the APS official conventional calendar and the district’s February 9, 2026 approval notice to resolve conflicting summary dates on the APS calendar page.
sourceReviewDetails: August 5, 2026 — The conventional calendar dates on this page were checked against the APS official calendar file and the February 9, 2026 calendar approval notice.

Source note: The date summary on the APS calendars webpage currently contains two apparent year errors. The district’s February 9, 2026 approval notice confirms August 10, 2026, for preschool and kindergarten and May 27, 2027, for grades K–12. Those are the dates used on this page.

We checked grade-band first days, preschool and K–12 last days, vacation ranges, holidays, professional release days, educator workdays, parent conference exchange days, and the Alternative Late Start Wednesdays notice.

customSections.label: Some APS Schools Use a Different Wednesday Schedule
customSections.content: Dalton, Escuela Bilingüe Betty Benavidez, Aurora Highlands, Aurora Quest, Clara Brown, and Mrachek follow the Alternative Late Start Wednesdays calendar. These schools start 75 minutes later on most Wednesdays. Check your school’s calendar before importing dates or making transportation and child care plans.

customSections.label: Why APS Uses Different Labels for No-School Days
customSections.content: APS separates professional release days, educator workdays, parent conference exchange days, holidays, and vacations on its official calendar. Students do not attend school on the staff and conference days listed below, even though those dates are not part of a longer vacation. The calendar also lists heritage months and community observances. These are informational and do not automatically mean that schools are closed.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Aurora Public Schools start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Students in grades 1–12 start Thursday, August 6, 2026. Preschool and kindergarten students start Monday, August 10.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school?
calendarFaqs.a: Preschool ends Wednesday, May 26, 2027. Grades K–12 end Thursday, May 27.

calendarFaqs.q: Which APS schools use the alternative late-start Wednesday calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Dalton, Escuela Bilingüe Betty Benavidez, Aurora Highlands, Aurora Quest, Clara Brown, and Mrachek follow the Alternative Late Start Wednesdays calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: What are professional release, educator work, and parent conference exchange days?
calendarFaqs.a: They are different APS calendar labels for no-school days. Students do not attend school on those dates, even when the day is not part of a longer vacation.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can families find translated calendars and verify changes?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official APS District & School Calendars page for English, Spanish, replacement files, and school-specific calendars. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and is not affiliated with Aurora Public Schools.
